title: Reverse Bits
description:
Reverse bits of a given 32 bits signed integer. 

 Example 1: 

 Input: n = 43261596 
 
 Output: 964176192 
 
 Explanation: 

 Integer 
 Binary 

 43261596 
 00000010100101000001111010011100 

 964176192 
 00111001011110000010100101000000 

 Example 2: 

 Input: n = 2147483644 
 
 Output: 1073741822 
 
 Explanation: 

 Integer 
 Binary 

 2147483644 
 01111111111111111111111111111100 

 1073741822 
 00111111111111111111111111111110 

 Constraints: 

 0 <= n <= 2 31 - 2 
 
 n is even.
